info.name: CampusSpace AI - Campus Resource Booking (P04)
info.description: Only @vnrvjiet.in accounts can sign in. Run `npm run seed` first, then run the whole collection in order with the Collection Runner. Auth uses the HTTP-only `token` cookie, which Postman stores automatically after each Login request.

exec: // Future booking times, recomputed on every request so the collection never goes stale.
const at = (days, h) => { const d = new Date(); d.setDate(d.getDate() + days); d.setHours(h, 0, 0, 0); return d; };
pm.test("Register - try to self-assign ADMIN -> 400", () => pm.response.to.have.status(400));
